popCulture.title: Labdacids
popCulture.description: The Theban house took his name: Labdacids — Labdacus, Laius, Oedipus, and the brothers who tore Thebes apart — a dynasty label that outlived the king himself.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: The Bibliotheca preserves Labdacus' short reign: the Cadmeid grandson who loses a border war with Athens and, like Pentheus, dies for slighting Dionysus — the thin ancient dossier behind the dynasty name.

popCulture.title: Labdacus
popCulture.description: Almost never painted in his own right, Labdacus survives as the eponym between Cadmus and Laius — the Theban king whose name marks the cursed house rather than a visual tradition.
